import bpy,json,numpy as np
ns=bpy.app.driver_namespace['ground15']
original=ns['sample'];env=original.__globals__;sm=env['sm'];baseheight=env['baseheight'];linear=env['linear']
def revised(x,y):
 h,col=original(x,y)
 inlet=(1-sm(.94,1.55,abs(y+.41)))*sm(4.12,4.4,x)*(1-sm(6.6,7.8,x))
 h=h*(1-inlet)+max(baseheight(x,y),1.004)*inlet
 soil=linear(np.array([165,148,111])/255)
 col=np.array(col)*(1-inlet)+soil*inlet
 return float(h),tuple(col)
ob=bpy.data.objects['M14 continuous sculpted shore bank'];me=ob.data
cols=[]
for v in me.vertices:
 h,col=revised(v.co.x,v.co.y);v.co.z=h;cols.append((*col,1))
ca=me.color_attributes['GroundTint']
for li,loop in enumerate(me.loops):ca.data[li].color=cols[loop.vertex_index]
me.update();ns['sample']=revised
print('STAIR_INLET',[(x,revised(x,-.4)[0]) for x in [4.48,4.88,5.51,6.16]])
bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=bpy.data.filepath)
